## Expert Lecture on “Role of Cloud Computing in Building Smart Energy Systems”

News Date : 07 Nov 2025News ReportExpert Lecture on “Role of Cloud Computing in Building Smart Energy Systems”TheIndustry–Institute Partnership Cell (IIPC), in collaboration with theDepartment of Computer Science and Engineering, organized anExpert Lectureon07 November 2025 (Forenoon)as part of its regular IIPC activities.The session featuredDr. B. Sainath,Senior Manager, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Hyderabad, who delivered an insightful talk on“Role of Cloud Computing in Building Smart Energy Systems.”The event witnessed enthusiastic participation from bothfaculty members and studentsof the Institute.In his inaugural address,Dr. G. Chandra Mohan Reddy, Principal, motivated the students to engage with emerging technological trends and address state-of-the-art challenges in the computing world.Dr. A. Nagesh, In-charge Head, Department of CSE, highlighted the importance of mastering cloud computing technologies and their real-time applications.During his lecture,Dr. B. Sainathemphasized that cloud security tools play a crucial role in encrypting data and detecting anomalies to safeguard critical energy infrastructure from cyberattacks. He also discussed the significance of real-time analysis of energy usage patterns, grid performance, and demand fluctuations—enabling data-driven decision-making for efficient energy management.The session concluded with a summary byDr. K. Rajitha, Member of IIPC, followed by avote of thanksproposed byDr. P. Chandra Sekhar, Convenor, IIPC.

## Expert Lecture on “Role of Cloud Computing in Building Smart Energy Systems”

TheIndustry–Institute Partnership Cell (IIPC), in collaboration with theDepartment of Computer Science and Engineering, organized anExpert Lectureon07 November 2025 (Forenoon)as part of its regular IIPC activities.
The session featuredDr. B. Sainath,Senior Manager, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Hyderabad, who delivered an insightful talk on“Role of Cloud Computing in Building Smart Energy Systems.”The event witnessed enthusiastic participation from bothfaculty members and studentsof the Institute.
In his inaugural address,Dr. G. Chandra Mohan Reddy, Principal, motivated the students to engage with emerging technological trends and address state-of-the-art challenges in the computing world.Dr. A. Nagesh, In-charge Head, Department of CSE, highlighted the importance of mastering cloud computing technologies and their real-time applications.
During his lecture,Dr. B. Sainathemphasized that cloud security tools play a crucial role in encrypting data and detecting anomalies to safeguard critical energy infrastructure from cyberattacks. He also discussed the significance of real-time analysis of energy usage patterns, grid performance, and demand fluctuations—enabling data-driven decision-making for efficient energy management.
The session concluded with a summary byDr. K. Rajitha, Member of IIPC, followed by avote of thanksproposed byDr. P. Chandra Sekhar, Convenor, IIPC.
